title: Predictable generator use (shell) — review required
description: Code in shell draws from a non-cryptographic generator: $RANDOM. Output is predictable, so security values built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the use; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to openssl rand.
remediation: Draw security values from openssl rand instead.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the generator regardless of purpose. Argument-taking generator calls are separate rules.
